conventions.crossing_point: point of the revolution's planned path (for a coarse tow file: resampled at 1 mm on the mesh) where it crosses the plane through the camera centre and the mandrel axis, on the camera side (STEP frame, mm)
conventions.offset_mm: shift of the as-laid tow at the crossing point along n x t (n outward surface normal, t planned path direction of travel)
conventions.angle_error_deg: as-laid minus planned fibre angle (rotation about the crossing point within the surface)
conventions.visible: the crossing point lies inside the crop polygon within the incidence limit
